text:
alex: Heads-up — found partner ingestion logs that include KMS-wrapped backup ciphertext for staging tenant 84. No plaintext seen, but wrapping key identifiers and ciphertext fragments are in the log. Need immediate containment + rotation plan.

maria: ok — what's the exact Vault path / KMS key id?

alex: vault path: `secret/data/backups/tenant-84` (mounted at `secret/backup/`). KMS wrapping info: `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/backups/cryptoKeys/wrap-key-v1` shows in the logs. Only ciphertext blobs appear, but partner SA had read access to the artifact store where logs landed.

jon: creating an incident ticket and pinging partner ops. oncall, pls watch.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-45 created (severity: high) — esk: @maria @devon @alex

devon: quick proposal: 1) revoke partner SA's read access to the bucket immediately 2) patch Vault mount RBAC to deny `read` to that SA 3) enable export of audit logs for `secret/backup/` to a locked project for verification 4) rewrap ciphertexts with a new KMS key and rotate transit key.

alex: +1. Order: revoke access -> RBAC patch -> enable audit sink -> dry-run rewrap -> schedule production rewrap. We need owners for each step and an ETA.

maria: I can push the RBAC patch and enable audit sink — will open a PR to infra/aws-iam in ~20m. PR: https://git.internal/infra/aws-iam/pull/ (will link when ready).

devon: I can run the rewrap script. Need temporary `vault-role=rewrap-runner` in the `vault-admin` group with permission to `read` ciphertexts and call the transit rewrap API.

alex: devon — I'll create the role and give you a 1-hour grant window once PR merges. Also we should avoid a global transit key rotate until after rewrap finishes; instead create a new wrap KMS key `wrap-key-v2` and rewrap blobs to it. Then rotate transit key with a controlled window.

jon: partner ops confirmed they pulled the logs but say no one on their side retained keys — still treat as data exposure. They've revoked their ingestion role for now.

security-bot: Audit sink created for `secret/backup/` -> projects/redwood-sec-audit (retention 90d).

maria: RBAC patch merged to staging branch, will rollout to staging in 10m then prod after smoke. Patch diff: `- bindings: partner-ingest-sa -> roles/secretReader` `+ bindings: partner-ingest-sa -> roles/denied` with conditional deny.

alex: checklist for rewrap (post to thread and attach logs):
```
# dry-run
vault list -format=json secret/backup/tenant-84 | jq -r '.[]' | xargs -n1 -I{} bash -c '\
  echo rewrap {}; vault read -field=ciphertext secret/backup/tenant-84/{} | base64 -d | \\
  curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $KMS_TOKEN" \\
    "https://cloudkms.googleapis.com/v1/projects/.../cryptoKeyVersions:asymmetricRewrap" \\
'\
```
Note: that's a dry-run pattern — actual prod run uses our `tools/rewrap` with batching and backoff.

devon: starting dry-run now and will post counts/errors.

devon: dry-run result: scanned 42 blobs; 42 eligible for rewrap; no decryption errors in dry-run. Posting logs to INC-2026-45.

alex: good. Proposed prod window: 02:00 UTC in ~4 hours (low traffic). Maria, can you schedule the RBAC/permission revoke to be done immediately and gate the rewrap to only start after we confirm revoke succeeded?

maria: revoke done for partner SA on bucket and artifact store. Verified: `gsutil iam get gs://partner-ingest-bucket` no partner bindings.

jon: oncall monitoring enabled for 03:00 UTC plus 2h. Alert if rewrap error rate >5% or >10m per blob avg.

alex: communication plan: send partner note (shared template) and notify product/security mailing list before 01:30 UTC. I'll draft. Also we need a quick policy change: disallow persistent export of wrapping key IDs into 3rd-party logs — adding masking at ingestion.

devon: about masking — I'll add a sanitizer step in the ingestion lambda to strip `cryptoKeyName` fields and redact `ciphertext` metadata. Small PR to infra-ingest in 30m.

security-bot: Rewrap job started (run-id: 2026-INC-45-1). Progress updates will post here.

devon: rewrap progress: 10/42 done, 0 errors. ETA ~12m.

devon: rewrap completed: 42/42 rewrapped to `wrap-key-v2`. Next: update metadata pointers in Vault to point to new ciphertext ids, then schedule transit key rotate.

alex: metadata update performed. I pushed `vault:metadata/rewrap/tenant-84` entries with new IDs.

maria: auditing checks: all access during the window came from `rewrap-runner` and `infra-admin`; partner SA attempts blocked. No unexpected principals.

jon: closing incident when transit rotation completes and customer notif sent.

alex: owners: alex (sec lead) — postmortem + customer comms; devon (infra) — rewrap tooling and run; maria (iam) — RBAC patch + audit export; jon (oncall) — monitoring + incident closure.

alex: quick postmortem notes to add later: root cause = ingestion pipeline leaked KMS resource names into partner logs. Remediation: masking, stricter SA scoping, rotate wrap key cadence to 90d, and add automated detection for KMS resource name exfiltration.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-45 resolved (duration: 5h 25m) — summary posted to #incidents.

alex: thanks everyone. I'll create the postmortem draft in a couple hours and link here.
